parser_repairs.root_cause: Browser title metadata, amendment controls and empty-state graphics were parsed as legal text/media.
parser_repairs.fix: Audit and exclude only source-backed interface artifacts; retain ordinary buttons and source media.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Replacement counters inside multiline quotations leaked into the enclosing legal hierarchy.
parser_repairs.fix: Balance explicit source quotation boundaries and represent their independent counters as local lists.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Article-free directives and correction letters remained in header/title sections.
parser_repairs.fix: Use source heading, alignment and substantive narrative boundaries to enter the body.

parser_repairs.root_cause: An authority displayed in a letterhead table could trigger the closing signature phase.
parser_repairs.fix: Preserve issuing-authority role in the initial header context.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Alphabetic counters in an article-free body became orphan legal points.
parser_repairs.fix: Retain source-backed numbered paragraphs without inventing articles or clauses.

parser_repairs.root_cause: A bounded counter restart below a colon lead-in duplicated legal clause numbers.
parser_repairs.fix: Keep the complete restarted sequence in its own evidenced enumeration scope.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Small signature tables without axis headers were ambiguous or prematurely ended an attached legal act.
parser_repairs.fix: Recognize explicit signing markers/delegation and keep local semantic signature blocks.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Legacy Kính gửi blocks and dash recipients were left as generic paragraphs.
parser_repairs.fix: Recognize the source addressee heading and preserve recipient/list context.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Hyphenated, suffix-letter and multiple-slash document numbers were omitted from relations/history.
parser_repairs.fix: Expand source-slice recognition while keeping primary citations and mentions separate.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Alphabetic sequences directly below an article colon lead-in became orphan points.
parser_repairs.fix: Represent consecutive local lists without synthesizing an absent legal clause.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Roman subdivisions and decimal items within an article were confused with clauses and orphan points.
parser_repairs.fix: Scope explicitly emphasized Roman outlines and their nested counters as local ordered lists.

parser_repairs.root_cause: A footnote immediately after an article number prevented article recognition.
parser_repairs.fix: Allow source footnote notation at the label boundary and preserve its text/annotation.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Bold or shaded td header bands lacked column associations.
parser_repairs.fix: Recognize explicit typography and reusable column labels; preserve physical cells, spans and conservative ambiguous axes.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Non-text colgroup/col layout declarations emitted unknown-element warnings.
parser_repairs.fix: Keep these declarations as table geometry metadata instead of legal-content units.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Repeated symbol/separator/definition rows were treated as ambiguous axis tables.
parser_repairs.fix: Keep their full physical geometry as key/value definition tables with no irrelevant role/confidence metadata.

parser_repairs.root_cause: A national heading/motto table with blank rows was mistaken for a data table.
parser_repairs.fix: Use meaningful rows and exact letterhead roles, retaining layout provenance.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Signing columns interrupted recipient groups; regrouping across rows could cross source order.
parser_repairs.fix: Keep explicit recipient continuation groups in source order and preserve individual layout-cell boundaries.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Alphabetic annex lists separated by formulas or explanatory paragraphs remained generic.
parser_repairs.fix: Build bounded consecutive annex lists with source-backed continuation blocks.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Whole-unit CSS font-weight evidence was ignored.
parser_repairs.fix: Recognize bold CSS as the same source heading evidence as bold/strong tags.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Contents entries became annex boundaries, and contract article/lettered appendix headings remained generic.
parser_repairs.fix: Scope explicit contents as source lists; recognize the contract form and retain local article/appendix headings and counters.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Decimal subdivisions in an article-free directive remained generic and lost their source prefix parent.
parser_repairs.fix: Attach explicitly punctuated decimal counters to their actual existing prefix; diagnose missing prefixes rather than inventing parents.

parser_repairs.root_cause: A signature and second letterhead locked an attached act into the closing phase.
parser_repairs.fix: Preserve intermediate closing/header roles as local layout blocks and restart legal counters in the canonical body.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Speculative heading coalescence could discard the title of a generic footer unit.
parser_repairs.fix: Restore the source title child whenever no legal node consumed the coalesced title.

parser_repairs.root_cause: An amended provision inside a source footer retained a clause marker as a generic paragraph.
parser_repairs.fix: Represent explicit article/clause excerpts as local counter lists inside their actual footnote.

parser_repairs.root_cause: English Article/Chapter/Section headings remained generic despite valid JSON.
parser_repairs.fix: Recognize source English legal labels and document headings, preserve separator punctuation, reject leading prose citations.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Hyphen clause counters and slash point counters were left as generic paragraphs.
parser_repairs.fix: Recognize spaced hyphen/slash numeric counters and slash alphabetic counters in legal and local list scopes; retain numeric ranges, fractions and inline ratios as ordinary text.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Unlabelled motivation paragraphs entered the body before an explicit source basis; a bare enacting formula could become a title.
parser_repairs.fix: Use the explicit following basis/formula before the first legal heading to preserve preamble scope; recognize unambiguous bare enacting formula labels.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Only the first Roman heading in an article-free circular was recognized; later emphasized siblings stayed generic.
parser_repairs.fix: Represent repeated emphasized Roman headings and their subordinate numeric/alpha counters as a local body outline, bounded by source legal/annex/closing labels.

parser_repairs.root_cause: A source quotation missing its closing mark let replacement clauses leak into the outer act.
parser_repairs.fix: Bound its local counters at the next explicit sequential amendment lead-in; preserve every character and emit a source-incomplete-quotation warning.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Clause inference stopped at a child table, missing explicit later sibling point b and leaving four orphan points.
parser_repairs.fix: Collect outer sibling point evidence across opaque child tables/lists; keep numeric-only sequence barriers and procedural-list contradictions unchanged.

parser_repairs.root_cause: A source td header with a parenthetical measurement unit was not recognized as a single named column label.
parser_repairs.fix: Match reusable source column-label vocabulary plus its explicit unit qualifier and preserve the complete original header text.

parser_repairs.root_cause: An assignment formula rendered with rowspan and a two-row expression was treated as an unresolved data table.
parser_repairs.fix: Use existing key/value table representation for an explicit single assignment spanning all source rows; retain all eight physical cells and grid geometry without invented axes.

parser_repairs.root_cause: An annex alphabetic sequence stopped at a nested dash list, leaving its final consecutive item generic.
parser_repairs.fix: Retain nested lists as opaque continuation children until the next source-backed alphabetic sibling or stronger boundary.

parser_repairs.root_cause: Plain A/B subdivisions carried explicit VBPL provision-heading classes but no bold markup, leaving them generic.
parser_repairs.fix: Use the source provision-heading class on uppercase headings and represent alphabetic subdivisions between Roman and numeric local-outline levels.

parser_repairs.root_cause: A source KT/ delegation title stayed generic inside an otherwise recognized signing block.
parser_repairs.fix: Recognize slash-delimited delegation abbreviations only when followed by an explicit authority; preserve the exact source spelling.

sampling_repairs: Issuing-body hint excludes Central citations later in Local titles.
Numeric identity is excluded from year hints.
Failed source cohorts contribute to diversity scoring.
note: No generated JSON or immutable RAW was manually repaired.

expectation_corrections.evidence: RAW Article 1 explicitly contains ten hyphen-delimited clauses (1- through 10-). The previous zero-clause expectation represented the parser omission.
expectation_corrections.change: Update pinned hierarchy to ten clauses; retain all warnings about source relations.

expectation_corrections.evidence: RAW Annex II section 1 contains consecutive a through i items with nested dash lists inside f and h.
expectation_corrections.change: Pin one continuous alphabetic sequence including i and its actual nested list children.

expectation_corrections.evidence: RAW III contains source-marked A/B headings with separate numeric subdivisions.
expectation_corrections.change: Pin those two local outline levels rather than generic paragraphs.

regression_discovered_repairs.root_cause: A bare annex label after a bare article label could be consumed as the article title during speculative coalescence.
regression_discovered_repairs.fix: Treat an actual annex candidate as a boundary in heading coalescence.
regression_discovered_repairs.evidence: Portable nested-annex-list regression exposed the boundary omission; no sampled capture required RAW changes.
